Reason for Mistake: The agent made an unverified assumption that the APOD city lights were from Duluth and then incorrectly linked the city’s namesake to Chicago’s John Hancock Center, which is unrelated. This speculative linkage led to naming the wrong landmark and firm (Skidmore, Owings & Merrill) instead of identifying the correct Chicago landmark tied to the city’s namesake. The error stems from misinterpretation and lack of evidence-based verification, resulting in an incorrect firm name.
